title: Former International Cooperation Ministry employees' vigil
location: Outside the Council of Ministers, Tripoli, Libya
scope: One local employee vigil; no broader coordinated-event boundary established.
organizer: Former Ministry of International Cooperation employees; organizing body not named.
threshold_50_evidence: unknown; report does not give attendee count or a clear qualitative threshold indicator.

start_date.summary: Article published Tuesday 29 Oct reports this occurred Sunday; 27 Oct is the weekday/date mapping, an inference, not an explicitly printed calendar date.

end_date.summary: No event duration or end date; null/unknown.

location.summary: Al-Ain says participants gathered outside the Council of Ministers in Tripoli.

state_target.summary: Participants demanded the government implement a court ruling/decision enabling them to work at the Foreign Affairs and International Cooperation Ministry and settle employment/financial status.

demands.summary: Employment placement and financial/administrative settlement fit labor_wage_dispute; no more specific code applied.

organizer.summary: Former ministry employees; formal organizer unknown.

threshold_50_evidence.summary: No count or qualitative crowd descriptor establishes 50 simultaneous attendees.

protester_violence.summary: Not addressed in read scope; unknown.

state_response.summary: No response to the gathering established; unknown.

notes: One source. Al-Ain explicitly says its account follows LANA reporting; no second independent confirmation. Date derived from 'Sunday' and the 29 Oct publication date. Candidate not verified for threshold.
open_questions: Can a permitted source establish exact date and turnout?
Did the court decision/job status demand continue in additional protests after Sunday?
Can independent reporting establish the size of this specific vigil?

title: Agriculture Ministry employees' vigil against sector transfer
location: Outside the Ministry of Agriculture and Livestock, Tripoli, Libya
scope: One local ministry employee vigil, distinct from other Tripoli employee gatherings by site/demand.
organizer: Employees of the Agriculture and Livestock Ministry; formal organizer not named.
threshold_50_evidence: unknown; no attendance estimate or scale description in the report.

start_date.summary: Article published Tuesday 29 Oct reports this occurred Sunday; mapping to 27 Oct is a calendar inference.

location.summary: Al-Ain locates it outside the Agriculture and Livestock Ministry in Tripoli.

state_target.summary: Employees opposed the government decision to transfer the agriculture sector to the Local Government Ministry.

demands.summary: Opposition to an official organizational decision; statement warns of poor coordination, delayed decisions and food-security effects.

threshold_50_evidence.summary: No quantitative or clear qualitative evidence for 50 simultaneous people.

state_response.summary: No response to the specific gathering established; unknown.

notes: One rendered news source; independence from other reports not established. Sunday date mapped to 27 Oct from publication date. Threshold unresolved.
open_questions: Can another permitted report establish date and turnout?
Was this a distinct gathering from other ministry workers, and what was the attendee count?
Were there follow-up protests after the decision?

title: Stalled-company workers' vigil for government action and arrears
location: Outside the Prime Minister's Council, Tripoli, Libya
scope: One public workers' vigil; this report describes one group of workers, not a nationwide aggregation.
organizer: Workers from stalled national companies and withdrawn foreign companies; no formal organizer named.
threshold_50_evidence: unknown; LANA report gives no attendance count or qualitative scale descriptor.

start_date.summary: LANA dates the vigil to 28 Oct; Al-Ain's 29 Oct report repeats the Monday event.

location.summary: LANA locates it at the Prime Minister's Council in Tripoli.

state_target.summary: Workers demanded the unity government implement promised solutions to stalled companies and pay employee dues/arrears.

demands.summary: Outstanding pay and employment/company status are labor_wage_dispute.

organizer.summary: Workers from national stalled and foreign withdrawn firms; formal organizer not named.

threshold_50_evidence.summary: No reported simultaneous count or clearly described large crowd.

protester_violence.summary: No explicit evidence in this report; unknown.

state_response.summary: Report does not document an event-specific government response; unknown.

notes: Al-Ain article explicitly attributes its account of the former ministry employee rally to LANA and also repeats this event; do not count it as independent corroboration. Use LANA as primary captured report. Threshold remains unknown.
open_questions: Can permitted reporting establish turnout at this vigil?
Did the company workers' protest continue on other dates, and was any multi-location action centrally organized?
Can the LANA report be independently corroborated without opening restricted sources?

title: Yefren residents’ demonstration against entry of armed formation
scope: One local public demonstration; no national or multi-site campaign boundary established.
threshold_50_evidence: unknown; the report describes popular demonstrations but gives no count or explicit crowd scale sufficient to establish 50 simultaneous participants.

start_date.summary: Libya Observer page dated 24 October 2024 says demonstrations took place Thursday; this explicitly fixes 24 Oct.

state_target.summary: Demonstrators demanded withdrawal of the armed formation; article says it belonged to the state Western Military Region, and quoted municipal council member separately called on the Western Military Region and national officials to withdraw it.

demands.summary: Textual demand is withdrawal of armed forces from Yefren. No listed demand category maps clearly; list left empty.

organizer.summary: Residents of Yefren; no formal organizing group named.

threshold_50_evidence.summary: “Popular demonstrations”/plural does not give an attendance count or explicit simultaneous scale; threshold unresolved.

protester_violence.summary: Report calls demonstrators peaceful; no protester violence described in reviewed text. Limited scope; retain unknown.

state_response.summary: Article attributes firing on peaceful demonstrators with injuries to a battalion belonging to the Western Military Region. Recorded as shootings=yes on this reported affiliation; no deaths or number of injured given. Attribution and chain of command are not independently confirmed.

notes: One report based on a Yefren municipal council member; no independent confirmation or turnout evidence. Article characterizes the entering formation as part of the Western Military Region, but command/control and local actor status are not independently verified. A November search result reports a 4 Nov arrest linked to resident demonstrations; onset likely predates November, but continuity is unresolved. Search-only leads from Akhbar Libya 24, Reportage, Al-Nas, Asharq Al-Awsat, HRS, Nabd, Almenassa and Al-Saaa 24 were inventoried as possible follow-up; none is used as body-verified threshold evidence. Several repeat statements from the same local municipal official, and no independence is assumed.
open_questions: Can another permitted source establish at least 50 simultaneous attendees at the 24 Oct gathering?
Was the formation under effective state command or an armed faction using the military-region label?
Was there a distinct public demonstration in November, or did the episode continue from 24 Oct?
When did the gathering/episode end, and were further gatherings held?
